cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(KumweEngine VERSION 0.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
include(CTest)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS "Enable AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer" OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_FUZZ "Build Clang libFuzzer entry point" OFF)
option(KUMWE_ENGINE_BENCHMARKS "Build diagnostic batch benchmark" OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The draft ABI supports 64-bit targets only")
endif()
if(MSVC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MSVC/Windows is not yet a supported development target")
endif()
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Werror -fstack-protector-strong)
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS)
  add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
set(ENGINE_SOURCES src/abi.cpp src/batch.cpp src/decimal/decimal.cpp src/value/json.cpp src/vm/decimal.cpp src/vm/formula.cpp src/document/document.cpp src/plan/plan.cpp src/reporting/report.cpp src/value/php_numeric.cpp src/canonical/canonical.cpp src/canonical/sha256.cpp)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/capabilities.json" ENGINE_CAPABILITIES)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/definition/formula-v1.json" ENGINE_FORMULA_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/validation-v1.json" ENGINE_DOCUMENT_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/reporting/materialization-v1.json" ENGINE_REPORT_CORPUS)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/canonical/generic-v1.json" ENGINE_CANONICAL_CORPUS)
# Bind runtime identity to source closure and the selected target/compiler recipe.
file(GLOB_RECURSE ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  "src/*" "include/*" "cmake/*" "corpus/*" "resources/*")
list(APPEND ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES CMakeLists.txt)
list(SORT ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES})
set(ENGINE_IDENTITY "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}|${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION}|${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}|${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}|${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}|${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}|${KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS}")
foreach(IDENTITY_FILE IN LISTS ENGINE_IDENTITY_FILES)
  file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${IDENTITY_FILE}" IDENTITY_HASH)
  string(APPEND ENGINE_IDENTITY "|${IDENTITY_FILE}:${IDENTITY_HASH}")
endforeach()
string(SHA256 ENGINE_BUILD_DIGEST "${ENGINE_IDENTITY}")
string(CONFIGURE "${ENGINE_CAPABILITIES}" ENGINE_CAPABILITIES @ONLY)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/capabilities.json" "${ENGINE_CAPABILITIES}")
configure_file(cmake/build_identity.hpp.in generated/build_identity.hpp @ONLY)
add_library(kumwe_engine STATIC ${ENGINE_SOURCES})
add_library(Kumwe::Engine ALIAS kumwe_engine)
set_target_properties(kumwe_engine PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES EXPORT_NAME Engine)
target_include_directories(kumwe_engine PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}> PRIVATE src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
target_compile_features(kumwe_engine PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
add_executable(kumwe-engine-conformance cli/conformance.cpp)
target_include_directories(kumwe-engine-conformance PRIVATE tests src)
target_link_libraries(kumwe-engine-conformance PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(canonical-tests tests/canonical_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(canonical-tests PRIVATE src tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  target_link_libraries(canonical-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME generic-canonical-corpus COMMAND canonical-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/canonical/generic-v1.json")
  add_executable(plan-tests tests/plan_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(plan-tests PRIVATE src tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  target_link_libraries(plan-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME compiled-plan-ownership COMMAND plan-tests)
  add_executable(report-numeric-tests tests/report_numeric_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(report-numeric-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(report-numeric-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME php-numeric-string-corpus COMMAND report-numeric-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/corpus/report-numeric-v1.json")
  add_executable(report-tests tests/report_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(report-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(report-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME report-materialization-corpus COMMAND report-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/reporting/materialization-v1.json")
  add_executable(document-tests tests/document_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(document-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(document-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME normalized-document-batch COMMAND document-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/document/validation-v1.json")
  add_executable(formula-tests tests/formula_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(formula-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(formula-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME definition-formula-corpus COMMAND formula-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/definition/formula-v1.json")
  add_executable(json-tests tests/json_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(json-tests PRIVATE src tests)
  target_link_libraries(json-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME lossless-json-transport COMMAND json-tests)
  add_executable(engine-tests tests/engine_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(engine-tests PRIVATE src)
  target_link_libraries(engine-tests PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  add_test(NAME behavior-boundary COMMAND engine-tests)
  add_test(NAME conversion-corpus COMMAND kumwe-engine-conformance "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/decimal/decimal-v1.tsv")
  add_executable(c-consumer tests/consumer/main.c)
  target_link_libraries(c-consumer PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  set_target_properties(c-consumer PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
  add_test(NAME plain-c-ownership COMMAND c-consumer)
  add_test(NAME architecture COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check-architecture.sh")
  if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    add_library(abi-visibility SHARED ${ENGINE_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(abi-visibility PRIVATE include src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
    set_target_properties(abi-visibility PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES)
    target_link_options(abi-visibility PRIVATE "LINKER:--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/abi-symbols.map" "LINKER:-z,relro,-z,now")
    # Clang resolves sanitizer runtime from the executable, not this test-only DSO.
    # Production release symbol-link checks retain -z,defs.
    if(NOT KUMWE_ENGINE_SANITIZERS)
      target_link_options(abi-visibility PRIVATE "LINKER:-z,defs")
    endif()
    add_test(NAME exported-symbols COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check-symbols.sh" "$<TARGET_FILE:abi-visibility>")
  endif()
endif()
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_FUZZ)
  if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libFuzzer requires Clang")
  endif()
  target_compile_options(kumwe_engine PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
  target_link_options(kumwe_engine INTERFACE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
  add_executable(engine-fuzz fuzz/boundary.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(engine-fuzz PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
  target_compile_options(engine-fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
  target_link_options(engine-fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
endif()
if(KUMWE_ENGINE_BENCHMARKS)
  add_executable(engine-benchmark benchmarks/decimal_batch.cpp)
  target_include_directories(engine-benchmark PRIVATE tests src)
  target_link_libraries(engine-benchmark PRIVATE Kumwe::Engine)
endif()
install(TARGETS kumwe_engine EXPORT KumweEngineTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT KumweEngineTargets NAMESPACE Kumwe:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/KumweEngineConfig.cmake.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfig.cmake" INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
write_basic_package_version_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfigVersion.cmake" VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY ExactVersion)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfig.cmake" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/KumweEngineConfigVersion.cmake" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/KumweEngine)
install(FILES LICENSE CHARTER.md "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/capabilities.json" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kumwe-engine)
